name: Seahaven Towers
description:
**Goal:** build all four foundations up from Ace to King, each in a single suit.

- Ten columns of five cards build **down in the same suit** (a 6 of spades on a 7 of spades).
- Four **free cells** hold one card each — two of them start with a card from the deal.
- Only a **King** may start an empty column, so freeing your Kings is the opening problem.
- A descending same-suit run can be dragged as a group, but only as far as free cells and empty columns could relay it by hand: **(1 + free cells) × 2 for each empty column**.
